author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
The rule regarding heavy bullying in the nightclub has specific terms set to it's usage. I know this because I made the rule and the training document. Unfortunately certain staff members, such as developers haven't actually been trained because they are not supposed to be punishing players unless absolutely necessary and if there are no other staff members available. Despite this they (or one in particular) have chosen to enforce rules anyways when there are staff members.
I was wondering why exactly a developer who has no training for TeamSpeak has server query?
Why are Developers and Senior Mods allowed to disclose personal information such as ip's without a user's permission? As a heads up my friend Adam (the one who recorded this) has changed his ip since this point in time and consents to me using this video. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iRDF_xoSh-E&feature=youtu.be
